Before Reporting lines that exist on paper but not in practice Two people doing one job, one person doing three Decisions bottlenecked at the top for things that should not need it Departments that do not know what the other is doing Growth plans built on top of an undefined structure After Traction Outsourcing A governance register that matches how the business actually runs Clear organograms across every entity in the group JDs and KPIs that remove ambiguity from senior roles A performance management system tied to the new structure A phased implementation roadmap, not a document that sits unused What We Rebuild Restructuring is not one document. It is the set of frameworks that have to move together. Governance Register Who decides what, and where authority actually sits. Organograms Reporting lines redrawn to match the real business, including across multiple entities. See how we approach this . JDs & KPIs Senior roles defined with clear accountability, not inherited job titles. Performance Systems A structure for measuring output that fits the new framework, not the old one. Policy Handbooks Staff policy that reflects the restructured business, not a template from elsewhere. Implementation Roadmap A week-by-week rollout, so the restructuring survives contact with the business. Ready to see what a rebuilt structure looks like for your business? What This Looks Like In Practice Multi-Entity Engineering Group Two entities under one group, each with its own history and its own way of doing things. We built a governance register, a dual-entity organogram, JDs and KPIs for six senior roles, a shared performance management system, and an eight-week roadmap to bring it all into one working structure. Engineering Services Firm Staff offer letters, a Code of Conduct, and a staff policy handbook covering multiple entities in one group, giving a growing engineering firm one consistent structure to onboard against instead of two conflicting ones. We Handle It End to End Restructuring is never only an organisational exercise. Ownership changes, shareholder agreements, statutory filings, governance documentation, and financial distress all have to be handled correctly for the new structure to actually hold. Traction Outsourcing Limited manages the full restructuring engagement. That means one point of contact for the entire process, from the governance rebuild and organogram design through to ownership structures, statutory and documentation requirements, and implementation. You do not have to coordinate multiple relationships or wonder which part of the process is being handled by whom. We manage it. All of it. Let's rebuild your structure, completely and correctly. Join Our Clients Businesses across Nigeria trust Traction Outsourcing Limited to get this right. 5 Legacy Frameworks Re-Engineered Across Lagos & Abuja Request A Free Consultation Leave your details and someone from our team will reach out. Common Questions What is corporate restructuring? Corporate restructuring is a deliberate reorganisation of a business's governance, ownership, reporting lines, staffing, and operational framework to address performance problems, prepare for growth, or adapt to a change in the business environment. It goes beyond cosmetic changes to the organogram and addresses the underlying structural causes of the problems the business is experiencing. Does Traction Outsourcing handle the full restructuring process, including ownership and statutory matters? Yes. Traction Outsourcing Limited manages every dimension of a restructuring engagement, including governance, organograms, role definitions, shareholder structures, ownership changes, statutory and documentation requirements, and implementation. You have one point of contact from start to finish. How long does a corporate restructuring take? It depends on the complexity of the business and the scope of the changes needed. A focused restructuring of a single-entity business with clear goals typically takes four to eight weeks. Group restructuring involving multiple entities, ownership changes, or financial distress takes longer. Traction Outsourcing builds a project timeline at the diagnostic stage so the client knows what to expect before work begins. What is the difference between corporate restructuring and startup structuring? Startup structuring builds foundations for a new or early-stage business that does not yet have a structure in place. Corporate restructuring rebuilds or reorganises the structure of an existing business that has outgrown, broken, or needs to change what it has. The tools overlap but the starting point and the process are different. Ready to Rebuild Your Structure? Speak with our consulting team about how Corporate Restructuring can work for your business. b: Areas Of Impact Startup Structuring Every strong business is standing on a structure nobody sees. We build that structure first, so the business you are growing does not outgrow itself. Most Nigerian businesses do not fail because the idea was weak. They fail because the founder was still writing job descriptions from memory in month eighteen, still deciding pay by conversation, still the only person who knew how anything worked. Growth without structure just means more people relying on a system that was never actually built. We fix that before it becomes expensive. How We Build The Foundation Three stages, done in sequence, so nothing is designed on top of a gap. 01 Registration & Preliminaries We help you set the tone of your business nomenclature, ensuring that it is unique and distinguishable. At this phase, we register your business or company ( CAC registration ), get you a Nigeria Revenue Service (NRS) Tax Identification Number, create a brand image for you, trademark your name in the appropriate class, get you your VAT certificate, create your official communication letters according to Corporate Affairs Commission stipulations and the Company and Allied Matters Act (CAMA), and register your company with three top-tier banks in Nigeria. Ensuring that you have a solid head start. 02 Design and Document We create a functional and capital organogram with reporting lines and role architecture around where the business is going, not just where it is today. We create job descriptions, KPIs, staff policy handbooks, and onboarding material. This gives you a concrete foundation to build your legacy business from day zero. 03 Deploy We train, assign roles, and ensure your team understands the fine print. We hand over a structure the team can step into immediately, with training where it is needed, so the business is not relying on the founder to explain it every time someone new joins. 10+ Structuring Projects, Last 6 Months 2 Sectors: Retail & Professional Services 100% Documented, Not Verbal What This Looks Like In Practice A look at the kind of structuring work we do, drawn from real engagements. Retail & Personal Care Business A growing retail business needed structure across seven roles before it could scale past its founder. We built the job descriptions, a commission framework for its frontline roles, and the staff attestation documents that gave the business its first real operating system. Gifting & Retail Business Twelve roles, one organogram, and a training deck built to onboard staff without the founder in the room. What used to be tribal knowledge became a structure new hires could pick up on day one. Join Our Clients Businesses across Nigeria trust Traction Outsourcing Limited to get this right. Request A Free Consultation Leave your details and someone from our team will reach out. Common Questions What is startup structuring? Startup structuring is the process of building the governance, legal, financial, and operational foundations a new business needs to function properly. It covers company registration, shareholding structure, role definitions, financial systems, and the HR and compliance frameworks that determine whether a business can grow in an organised and legally sound way. What does my startup need to get started properly? Most startups need four things in place before they can operate soundly: a registered company with the correct shareholding structure, a clear definition of who does what and who reports to whom, a basic financial management system, and employment contracts or consultant agreements for anyone working in the business. Traction Outsourcing Limited builds these foundations as a structured engagement rather than a checklist. How is startup structuring different from business registration? Business registration is one step inside startup structuring. Registration gives your company a legal identity. Structuring builds everything else: governance, organogram, financial framework, HR policies, and operational procedures. Many registered companies operate without structure and face problems with investor readiness, compliance, and internal accountability as a result. When is the right time to structure a startup? The right time is before the problems that come from no structure arrive: disputes between founders, confusion about roles, inability to onboard staff properly, or difficulty presenting the business to investors or partners. Traction Outsourcing Limited works with founders at pre-launch and early-growth stage, but also with businesses that have been operating informally for years and need to formalise what already exists. Ready to Structure Your Startup? Speak with our consulting team about how Startup Structuring can work for your business. Thank you. Someone from our team will reach out shortly.
